transactions.citation: p6348 (Note 6b, FY2024): 'entered into a purchase and sales agreement for the proposed divestment of 2401 Walsh Avenue and 2403 Walsh Avenue at a proposed sale price of US$160.2 million (based on 90% ownership interest). The properties were sold to a third-party at the carrying amount as at 31 December 2023 and sale of the properties was completed on 12 January 2024'
transactions.notes: Sold at exactly the 31-Dec-2023 carrying amount, i.e. zero gain/loss (0.00%), stated by the AR itself ('sold ... at the carrying amount'), not derived from a residual. 100%-basis carrying amount/sale price is US$178.0m (Note 6, p177 prior extraction); the AR also separately quotes a 90%-ownership-interest proposed price of US$160.2m (announced Nov 2023) — that figure is on a DIFFERENT (90%) interest basis than the 100% carrying value used here and is not used as reference_value to avoid mixing interest bases (spec invariant 1). No P&L divestment-gain line exists for this sale (net_property_sales = 0 per prior _notes.json), consistent with a nil-gain sale at book value.

transactions.citation: p7013 (Note 22): 'On 19 April 2024, the Group acquired a 24.9% equity interest in the Frankfurt Facility for a total purchase consideration of US$128.7 million, increasing its ownership interest of the associate from 25.0% to 49.9%'; p1058: 'acquiring an additional 24.9% equity stake in the Frankfurt Facility from Digital Realty for EUR117 million (approximately US$129 million)'
transactions.notes: FIRST of two 2024 tranches on the same asset (Frankfurt Facility / Wilhelm-Fay-Straße 15 and 24) — recorded as a SEPARATE acquisition row per spec, with its own deal_id, since this was still an associate step-up (25.0% -> 49.9%), not the change-of-control event. interest_pct = 0.249 is the stake acquired in THIS tranche only. Accounted for as an investment in associate, not an acquisition of a subsidiary (that treatment applies only to the December tranche, which triggered consolidation).

transactions.citation: p7015 (Note 22 narrative): 'On 5 December 2024, the Group further acquired an additional 15.1% equity interest in the Frankfurt Facility ... increasing its ownership interest from 49.9% to 65.0%. This resulted in a change in control of the Frankfurt Facility from associate to subsidiary'; p7037-7039 (Note 22 acquisition-effects table): 'Purchase consideration on equity interest 29,442' + 'Purchase consideration on shareholder loan acquired 47,955' = 'Total purchase consideration 77,397' (US$'000); cash outflow net of cash acquired = 55,077
transactions.notes: SECOND of two 2024 tranches on the same asset — separate deal_id from the April tranche per spec ('record interest_pct for each; they are separate acquisitions of the same asset'). interest_pct = 0.151 is the increment acquired in December, taking cumulative stake from 49.9% to 65.0%. purchase_price uses the Note 22 acquisition-effects TABLE figure (US$77,397k = equity consideration US$29,442k + shareholder-loan consideration US$47,955k), NOT the Note 22 NARRATIVE figure of 'US$128.7 million' quoted in the same note (p7015) — that narrative figure is IDENTICAL, word-for-word, to the April tranche's consideration quoted two sentences earlier (p7013) and does not reconcile with the December acquisition-effects table, the cash-flow statement (net outflow US$55.1m), or the ~EUR71m (~US$75-77m) figure our prior extraction sourced from elsewhere in the AR. Treated as a report duplication/OCR artifact per spec rule 5 ('never balance by assumption') — the reconciling table figure is used and the discrepancy is recorded here rather than silently resolved.

transactions.citation: p1056: 'Digital Core REIT acquired an additional 10% equity interest in the Osaka Data Centre from Mitsubishi Corporation in March 2024, for JPY7,725 million (approximately US$51.5 million), bringing its total stake to 20%'; p6502 (Note 8a): 'On 29 March 2024, the Group increased the effective interest in Digital Osaka 2 TMK from 10% to 20% and the investment was reclassified from financial asset at FVOCI to an associate'
transactions.notes: interest_pct records the INCREMENT acquired (10%, i.e. 0.10), not the resulting 20% total stake, per spec explicit guidance for this exact case. purchase_price JPY7,725m converted in the AR to ~US$51.5m; recorded in USD as disclosed.
